bio_short: KOVA builds sets out of long, patient builds and a lot of low end. Two EPs, a residency at Smart Bar, and a live rig that leaves room for the room.
bio_long:
KOVA is a Chicago producer and DJ working between melodic house and live electronics. The sets are built around long, patient builds and a lot of low end, played from a rig that keeps enough unfixed to respond to the room.

Since 2023 there have been two EPs, a monthly residency, and support slots across the Midwest. The 2026 record is being written in a basement in Pilsen and will be finished when it is finished.

demo.text: Demo site. KOVA is a fictional artist; the audio was synthesised for this build.
